items.text:
7. EXTENSION – BUS ZONE
Fitzgerald Avenue, south side, from 76 feet to 233 feet east of Keith Street (removes 6 parking
spaces) (Supervisor District 10) Hester Yu, [staff email removed — see the order]

The proposed modification extends the existing 29 Sunset bus zone to accommodate the number of
buses at the terminal.

Public Comments: Comments in opposition.
Decision: Proposal modified and approved by the City Traffic Engineer to be sent to the SFMTA Board
for final approval. The proposal is less restrictive, with a full-time bus zone from 76 feet to 151 feet
east of Keith Street and a part-time bus zone, 6 am to 7 pm, Monday through Friday, from 151 feet to
233 feet east of Keith street.

  Sustainable Streets Division

ESTABLISH – BIKE SHARE STATION
